verdict.rationale: Jules can take a task described in natural language or a GitHub issue labeled "jules", generate a plan for approval, change code in a cloud VM, and open a PR. One independent report says a non-engineer customer now makes their own PRs with it and it works about 75% of the time. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can take a mockup or design file as input. Hands-on reports also say it needs babysitting and back-and-forth fixing, and that output is weak beyond simple problems, so an engineering-free path is not reliable. Missing for 10: mockup/image/design-file input, any documented design-to-code workflow, evidence that non-engineers reliably get working results without engineering review.
